sloka: तं दृष्ट्वा मुनिमायान्तं वैदेह्या मुनिपत्नयः ।उपाजग्मुर्मुदा युक्ता वचनं चेदमब्रुवन् ।। ७.४९.१९ ॥
transliteration: taṁ dṛṣṭvā munimāyāntaṁ vaidehyā munipatnayaḥ ।upājagmurmudā yuktā vacanaṁ cedamabruvan ।। 7.49.19 ॥

translations.english: Seeing the sage approaching with Vaidehi, the wives of the sages, filled with joy, came forward and spoke these words.
